Job description 
 Our client specializes in solving logistical challenges that others cannot handle. Whether it’s a large machine part, a box of special screws, or medical equipment, their drivers ensure every delivery is handled carefully and delivered on time. 
For this position, we are looking for a driver with a strong sense of responsibility.
 What does the job involve? 
    
• Daily start times vary between 05:00 and 08:00, with your schedule sent by SMS the evening before
    
• Finishing times are flexible, as new assignments can come in throughout the day
    
• You will drive across the Benelux and occasionally beyond, delivering to hospitals, factories, and companies in cities such as Rotterdam, Amsterdam, and Brussels
    
• You transport one load per trip (dedicated transport): directly from point A to point B
    
• After a delivery in places like Düsseldorf, you may continue through Amsterdam and Antwerp before returning home
    
• Some days involve only national trips, usually shorter routes but following the same dedicated transport principle
    
• You will cover many kilometers while generally being home every weekend
    
• Most assignments are day trips, although overnight stays in the truck are possible by agreement
 Flexibility & work-life balance 
The dispatcher takes your private schedule into account whenever possible with timely communication, but flexibility remains essential for this role.
 Depot location 
Your truck starts and ends each day at the depot in Duffel, so having your own transport to reach the location is required.

 Requirements 

    
• CE driving license + Code 95
    
• Strong sense of responsibility
    
• Independent working attitude
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English

ABOUT THE JOB
 
 

• Advising clients ranging from innovative start-ups to multinational companies on trademark, design and related IP matters. 

• Managing national, European and international trademark and design portfolios. 

• Conducting trademark clearance searches and providing availability opinions. 

• Drafting, filing and prosecuting trademark and design applications before the BOIP, EUIPO, WIPO and foreign intellectual property offices. 

• Handling opposition, cancellation and invalidity proceedings. 

• Advising on infringement, unfair competition and IP enforcement strategies. 

• Drafting legal opinions, cease-and-desist letters, coexistence agreements, assignments and licence agreements. 

• Assisting clients in developing and implementing pragmatic IP protection strategies. 

• Liaising with clients, foreign associates and intellectual property offices worldwide. 

• Monitoring legislative and case law developments and translating these into practical advice for clients. 

• Working closely with a team of experienced attorneys, legal professionals and paralegals.  

YOUR PROFILE
 
 

• Education: Master's degree in Law, preferably with an additional qualification in Intellectual Property. 

• Experience: Some experience in IP law and/or trademark and design protection, preferably in private practice. 

• Languages: Excellent written and oral communication skills in Dutch and English; other languages are a plus. 

• Mindset: Pragmatic, proactive, client-oriented, and self-motivated. 

• Skills: Attention to detail, ability to handle confidential cases discreetly, and strong prioritization skills. 

• Teamwork: Ability to work both individually and seamlessly within a team.

Are you a student with a passion for hospitality and a bit of restaurant experience under your belt? We’re looking for motivated and service-minded individuals to join our team as part-time 
waiters/waitresses!

If you’ve worked in a restaurant before and enjoy the buzz of a busy shift, this is the perfect opportunity to grow your skills in a vibrant, team-oriented environment.
 

What You'll Do
 
 

• Welcome guests and take orders with confidence and a smile 

• Serve food and drinks efficiently and professionally 

• Provide excellent customer service, even during peak hours 

• Help keep the dining area clean and organized 

• Collaborate closely with kitchen and bar staff  

What We’re Looking For
 
 

• Some previous experience in a restaurant, café, or similar setting (required) 

• A positive attitude and strong communication skills 

• Ability to stay cool under pressure 

• Flexibility to work evenings and weekends 

• Fluent in Dutch and/or English  

What We Offer
 
 

• A fun, dynamic workplace with a supportive team 

• Flexible scheduling to fit around your studies 

• Opportunities to learn and grow within the hospitality industry  

 Location: RAFFAT, Naamsestraat 45, 3000 Leuven 

 Hours: 6-18 hours per week

Ready to bring your experience to the table?
Send us your CV and a short message telling us about your past experience and availability to info@raffat.be
 

We look forward to meeting you!

You will leave early and drive for quite a few hours, but you will still sleep in your own bed every night. You will receive your schedule via the onboard computer (Transics), so you can usually depart from home.

All hours are paid, and in case of any issues, you can always rely on the planning team that will support you. So, if you are a motivated driver with some experience who wants to earn a good income while being home every day, please contact us, and we will ensure you can start quickly!

 Requirements 

    
• License C/CE with the necessary certificates
    
• Good knowledge of the European road network
    
• Physically fit, you load & unload yourself
    
• Experience as a driver and within the sector
    
• Independent, safety, and collegial are some of your keywords
    
• Good knowledge of Dutch/English

Job description 

Earn like an international driver while being home every day!

    
• Collection of waste and press containers with recycled paper
    
• Daily trips within Belgium to companies
    
• Flexible start times between 03:00 and 06:00
    
• Average of 12 working hours per day, with the possibility to work more if desired

Interested? Apply now!

 Requirements

• Valid Code 95
    
• Experience is required
    
• Flexible attitude
    
• Dutch-speaking or good command of English

We're on the lookout for a 
Mid-Level AI Systems Engineer who bridges AI engineering and MLOps. Someone who loves getting hands-on with LLMs, agents, and RAG pipelines, and who cares just as much about what happens once a model reaches production as about building it in the first place. In this role, you'll design, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems, with a strong focus on generative AI, LLM-based applications, and reliable machine learning operations. In practice your time is split roughly between 60-70% AI Engineering and 30-40% MLOps.
 

In this role you sit at the intersection of engineering and operations, working across teams and disciplines. You'll report to the Head of ML at Sagacify and collaborate with the wider Sagacify and Craftzing delivery organisation. A role that can naturally grow towards a Team Lead position over time.
 

What you'll do :
 

AI Engineering (60-70%)
 
 

• Orchestrate AI system components: LLMs, vector databases, APIs, orchestration layers, and user interfaces 

• Develop autonomous agents and conversational systems that can plan actions and interact with external tools or APIs 

• Build and optimise RAG pipelines connecting enterprise data sources to LLMs for grounded, contextualised, reliable answers 

• Evaluate system quality through generative AI metrics, coherence tests, and production monitoring (latency, API costs, bias) 

• Deploy and scale solutions with strong attention to latency, security, reliability and cost efficiency 

• Keep an eye on the ecosystem for new models, frameworks and techniques, including open-source tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, etc. 

• Perform prompt and context engineering to improve output quality, reduce hallucinations, and manage conversational state effectively  

MLOps (30-40%)
 
 

• Build and maintain automation for model deployment, including CI/CD pipelines and automated testing 

• Continuously monitor model performance in production, including drift detection and quality metric tracking 

• Manage updates of libraries, models, and related dependencies in production environments 

• Ensure versioning, reproducibility and safe rollout of models and AI services 

• Collaborate closely with ML engineers, developers, DevOps and infrastructure teams for smooth delivery 

• Stay current with the latest MLOps practices, tools and platform components  

You stay in the code, you stay curious about what happens after deployment, and you keep learning as you go.

 

• You have 3 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering or related fields 

• You have a solid understanding of LLM fundamentals: Transformers, attention mechanisms, generation parameters and fine-tuning approaches 

• You have strong problem-solving ability and algorithmic creativity 

• You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

• You have a team spirit and enjoy collaborating across multiple roles 

• You bring rigour, responsiveness and a good incident-handling mindset 

• You're autonomous, curious, and quick to learn new tools 

• You can communicate fluently in Dutch, English and French, or at least the first two languages  

Don’t worry if you don’t tick every single box, what matters most is the right mindset and a drive to learn. If you think we’re a match, we’d love to hear from you.

After a few years in finance, you know the difference between running the accounting and running the numbers. You have done the closings, the VAT returns, the audit files. What you want now is a role where controlling and business partnering matter as much as the statutory work, and a clear path to Finance Manager within three to five years.
 

That is this role.
 

Our partner is a global law firm with a well-established Brussels office and an integrated global finance organization. The transactional accounting is progressively moving to a shared service centre, which means the Brussels finance seat is evolving toward controlling, tax and business partnering. You report to the Finance Manager and work daily with the Office Managing Partner, the COO and the local business teams.
 

Your impact as Senior Accountant & Controller
 
 

•  

Full ownership of the monthly close for the Belgian entity, including all general ledger work and the fixed asset cycle
  

•  

Controlling, budgeting, forecasting and cost analysis in close partnership with senior management and the local business teams
  

•  

The Belgian tax and statutory backbone, from VAT and Corporate Income Tax to audit files and government submissions
  

•  

Balance sheet integrity and clean reconciliations across the perimeter, in line with the group's controls framework
  

•  

Continuous improvement of finance processes, from reporting tools to the impact of shared services on the local scope
   

You are the Belgian finance anchor of a global firm, on the path to Finance Manager.
 

Your profile as Senior Accountant & Controller
 
 

•  

Bachelor or Master in Finance, Accounting or similar
  

•  

3 to 10 years of experience with controlling and (tax) accounting exposure
  

•  

Fluent in French or Dutch (native level), with full English proficiency
  

•  

Experience with Belgian VAT, Corporate Income Tax and legal finance systems is a strong plus

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to architect and design the future of technology-aware networks in compute systems.µ
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced Network Architect/Researcher to join our team. In this position, you will play a key role in pathfinding future network designs enabled by emerging architectural and technological innovations (e.g., photonic/optical interconnect, wireless, etc.). 

This R&D role focuses on network architecture and design at all levels of a compute system, spanning networks-on-chip, IO chiplets/dies, scale-up and scale-out network at machine-scale, depending on the impact of emerging technologies in various application domains. You will be expected to collaborate with experts from application, technology, circuit, and design domains to evaluate the impact of technological innovations in network architecture of the future.
 

Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in applications, technology, circuits and design (across imec) to define novel technology-aware network architectures.  

• Lead feasibility studies through performance modeling and prototyping to provide expert guidance on design and implementation of next-gen network architectures.  

• Engage in R&D activities within project teams to take research ideas towards higher maturity levels, solving hands-on technical and engineering challenges in the process.  

• Stay up to date with the advancements in network architectures in compute systems, specifically in terms of novel technologies, design, and application domains.  

• Contribute to project definitions and the technical scope of work (timeline, work packages, milestones, deliverables) in close cooperation with the stakeholders.  

• Supervise or assist in mentoring Masters/Doctoral students/interns when necessary, and contribute to improved ways of working and shared knowledge across CSA.  

• Publish relevant results and artefacts in high-impact journals, conferences, seminars and open-source ecosystems to highlight CSA contributions to the community.  

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or relevant domains with strong R&D experience in network architecture/design.  

• You have 6+ years of relevant experience in industry and/or academia (we encourage you to apply if you have slightly less experience but strong alignment with the role).  

• You have proven expertise in network architecure/design, including topology, routing, congestion control, communication protocols, resilience, and performance analysis.  

• You have a good understanding of optical or electrical circuit switching, and you are familiar with recent industry initiatives around Ultra-ethernet, CXL, UALink, etc.  

• You have hands-on experience with network profiling and detailed network modeling tools such as NS3, OMNET++, SST Merlin, gem5 Garnet, AstraSim, etc.  

• You have experience developing system-level architectural models for networks, quantitative analysis frameworks, or system-level evaluation methodologies.  

• You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, with an experience in designing and executing experiments to derive insights from complex system behavior.  

• You are able to collaborate across abstraction layers, translating technology, circuit, and design information into meaningful architectural and system-level insights.  

• You have the knowledge and experience with good software and research engineering practices (e.g., version control, reproducibility, automation, testing, documentation).  

• You enjoy being hands-on while working with your colleagues and while mentoring students/interns, promoting a team culture of creativity, collaboration, and excellence.  

• You are a team player and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs; you are self-motivated, responsible and willing to take ownership.  

• You feel at home and know how to integrate into a multicultural environment; you are open-minded, you seek and embrace differences and accept constructive challenges.  

• You have effective English communication skills for discussions, documentations, and dissemination of ideas and results within CSA/IMEC and in wider ecosystems.

Job description 

Are you someone who enjoys getting on the road and loves long drives? Do you have a CE driving license and are you looking for a job where you can rack up the miles? Then definitely read on!

What will you do?

You will deliver new, empty oil drums with a mega trailer. You leave every day from Lier and primarily drive in Belgium and the Netherlands. You start between 4 AM and 7 AM and make between 3 to 8 stops a day. Sometimes you unload the drums yourself (for a nice extra fee). Occasionally, there is work on Saturdays, but that's at 150% pay.

What do we expect?

You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English. You possess a CE driving license with the necessary documents. You have some experience driving a mega trailer. Physical work is not a problem for you, and you do it with a smile.You may be required to operate different types of trailers and transport various kinds of goods. Therefore, it is important that you are flexible and open to a variety of tasks.

What do you get?

A well-filled odometer - lots of miles to cover. A stable job at a company that values you. Attractive and fair compensation, including extras for physical tasks and weekend work. Job security and a fixed departure and arrival location in Lier.

Are you eager to hit the road? Let us know and respond today!

 Requirements 

    
• You possess a CE driving license and all necessary documents (Code 95, driver card).
    
• You have experience driving a mega trailer.
    
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
    
• You enjoy working with different types of trailers and various goods. No day is the same!
    
• Physically demanding work does not deter you, and you carry out your tasks with a smile.
    
• You have your own transportation to get to the site.

Job description

 Requirements
